<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is produced through [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. When used the potion applies the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff, severely increasing damage dealt but at the cost of {{Health}}.

==Effect==
On use, the potion will apply the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff for a duration of 5 minutes. This buff increases player's damage by {{Health|+|15}} while dealing {{Health|-|1}} damage to the player every 7.5 seconds.
